set.body: Goal: make Stat a typed data transform instead of a declared-but-rejected enum. A stat consumes a layer's rows and emits a typed stat frame with its own computed aesthetics (count, density, bin midpoints); Stat.Identity stays free, Stat.Count becomes real (bar-style counts per discrete x). Acceptance: StatPhase between mapping and row evaluation; stat output feeds scale training and geom lowering; unsupported combinations stay typed errors; parity fixture against R table()/ggplot2 stat_count for a reference dataset; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: typed stats pipeline
